learner_starting_state: Has completed every mapped concept and Foundry implementation lesson through Content Understanding.
learner_ending_state: Can map evidence to every current AI-901 objective, distinguish conceptual from implementation evidence, and mark each objective ready or remediate without relying on confidence alone.
mastery_gate: Score 30 of 30 on primary and fresh-transfer forms, covering objective selection and evidence for all 15 AI-901 objectives, with no objective left unassessed and a closed-note domain explanation.

provenance_policy.citation_expectation: The current AI-901 study guide controls objective names and scope; official Microsoft Foundry and Azure AI pages support current product claims.
provenance_policy.unsupported_claim_behavior: Reverify exam objectives, weights, portal labels, SDK/APIs, model and tool availability, pricing, previews, and deprecations before the final readiness decision.

notes: Offline review only; this lesson makes no service call or external decision and does not claim Microsoft exam questions or guaranteed exam results.
